description: Action/Redact: In-place redaction of a local file. Replaces PII and secrets with tokens and saves the file. By default, creates a .bak backup. Use dry_run=true to test without modifying.

dry_run.description: If true, does not modify the file, only returns the metrics and a preview.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to redact.

no_backup.description: If true, does not create a .bak file. Use with extreme caution!

profile.description: The detection profile to use. Defaults to 'General'.

name: redact_file
